title: Thorn and Spire
author: August Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Delacroix, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
